notes.title: 🩸 Two Shadows, Two Fates
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]The roster grows darker.   

This week, two new waifus descend into the fight—and they’re not here to play nice.  

🌿 Thea, the Withering Warden, speaks for the wild places long forgotten. She heals what she chooses, curses what she remembers. Her smile is soft, her roots are deep—and they don’t let go.  

🩸 Grynn, the Blade of Silent Vows, once showed mercy. But precision is cleaner. Faster. Final. Every movement calculated, every gaze a warning. She's not here to save you—just to finish the job.

Grynn is a limited-time drop available until July 20. When she vanishes, she won’t leave a trace.  

Let us know who you're summoning first—or if you're bold enough to chase both shadows.  

See you in the next loop, Commander.[/p]

notes.title: Sweet & Rare Waifu Update
notes.notes:
[b]🌟 You asked, we listened: Easier Rare Waifus! 🌟[/b]

Your wishes have been granted—this update is all about getting those elusive rare Waifus into your collection!

[list]
[*][b]🥚 Supercharged Eggs:[/b] Crafted Eggs now have significantly boosted drop rates for 4 and 5-star Waifus.
[*][b]⬆️ Level Up Luck:[/b] Increased bonus from Account Level progression—higher levels now mean an even better chance for those dreamy high-tier pulls.
[*][b]👆 Click More, Wait Less:[/b] Each click now reduces the cooldown timer even more—tap your way to new Waifus faster!
[*][b]🍬 Candies Buffed:[/b] Candies now reduce timer by 20 minutes instead of 10. Sweet treats indeed!
[*][b]🖥️ Enhanced Idle Performance:[/b] Minimizing the game uses far fewer resources—perfect for efficient, hassle-free idling.
[*][b]🐞 Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the pesky scrolling bug in the crafting menu.
[/list]

[i]We heard your feedback loud and clear—happy clicking, anon! ❤️[/i]

notes.title: Echo & Iris, Sylphie, Celeste, and Lumi are ready for you!
notes.notes: [b]🎉 New Update! Five New Waifus, Candy Fixes & Story Expansions! 🍬[/b] Ready for some fresh clicks and deeper bonds? Let’s break down what’s new in this juicy update: [b]💫 Five Brand New Waifus Join the Roster![/b] Say hello to the latest additions in your collection — each one bringing her own unique flavor, lore, and charm: [b]Echo[/b] – The chaotic little sister with a badge, a temper, and zero respect for protocol. [b]Iris[/b] – Ice-cold lawyer with a soft spot buried deep beneath snark and espresso. [b]Celeste[/b] – Astrology-obsessed finance girly who fully believes Mercury retrograde tanked her crypto. [b]Sylphie[/b] – Ballerina turned silent daydreamer, with a past too beautiful (and maybe too strange) to be real. [b]Lumi[/b] – Quiet, snow-soft wallflower with a brain full of warmth and emotional algorithms she’s still learning to name. Each comes with her own full story arc and hundreds of new lines — so get tapping to unlock the lore! [b]📜 New Feature: Waifu Stories in Profiles[/b] You can now access each Waifu’s story progression directly in their profile gallery. No more guessing what they said three unlocks ago — your emotional bonding is now fully catch-up compatible. [b]🍭 Candy System Fixes[/b] We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear! With the timer reduced in the previous update, candies were feeling a little… too sweet. Candy time reduction has been nerfed to reflect the faster progress loop. It’s still tasty, but no longer game-breaking. 🍬 More tweaks and juicy surprises are in the works! For now — enjoy the new girls, read their stories, and see who’s been tracking your egg timer. 😉 [i]– The Waifu Team 💖[/i]

notes.title: Re-balancing... and a whole bunch of new Waifus
notes.notes:
Hey Waifu Collectors! It’s update time, and we’ve got some MAJOR changes rolling in! Faster timers, better drops, new waifus, and a few roster adjustments—read on for the full breakdown!

⸻

🔥 Major Changes & Fixes:

✅ Timer Reduction! – The 24-hour wait is OVER! Timers have been slashed to just 3 hours! That means faster unlocks, more waifus, and less suffering.
✅ Click to Speed Up! – Clicking now reduces the timer slightly, so get tapping!
✅ Candies Adjusted – Since timers are already much shorter, candies now reduce time by 5 minutes instead of their previous effect. Still sweet, just… less OP.
✅ Better Drops for Higher Levels! – Your Account Level now affects drop rates—the higher your level (up to 500), the better your chances at snagging Legendary waifus.

⸻

🆕 4 New Waifus Have Arrived!

Welcome Astrid, Nyx, BunBun, and Zoe to the roster! Each brings a unique twist to your collection:
💉 [b]Astrid[/b] – The cybernetic mad scientist pushing the limits of transhumanism.
🐾 [b]Nyx[/b] – The smooth-talking, law-dodging nekko from Noctis-12.
🎉 [b]BunBun[/b] – A high-energy party girl who lives for the thrill of the moment.
🎮 [b]Zoe[/b] – A game dev working on Husbandu Simulator (yes, really).

Collect them all and see what chaos they bring to your waifu lineup!

⸻

❌ Limited Waifus Leaving the Drop Pool

Some waifus are rotating out of the standard drop pool:
❌ Cupinne (Limited) has been removed—hope you grabbed her while you could!
❌ Shizuku and Clara have also been vaulted for now. Don’t worry, they might return someday… or maybe not. Who knows? 😏

⸻

🚀 Update Now & Start Clicking!

Faster drops, new waifus, and better rewards for dedicated players—this update is all about making waifu collection more exciting than ever!

Hop in, click away, and let us know what you think! (And don’t forget to flex your new waifus in the community!) 💖

🔹 Got feedback? Let us know in the Steam discussions!
🔹 Follow for future updates!

See you in the game! 🚀✨

notes.title: 💘 Swipe Right on Love—The Cupinne Valentine’s Event is LIVE! 💘
notes.notes:
Get ready to fall head-over-heels because Cupinne, the tech-savvy billionaire matchmaker, is launching straight into your heart this Valentine’s season! She’s a limited-time exclusive waifu here to stir up affection, spark connections, and maybe—just maybe—crash your heart’s operating system.

💡 Event Details:
📅 Available Until: March 7, 2025
🎯 How to Unlock: Unlockable with Eggs.

💖 Why Cupinne Will Hack Your Heart:
She’s not just another pretty face—she’s the brilliant mind behind Fu-fu Match, the ultimate app for soulmates (and waifu collectors, obviously). A hopeless romantic wrapped in a business mogul’s flair, she’s here to test your compatibility algorithm… with herself.

“I’ve seen a lot of matches, but this? This might just be my favorite click yet.” — Cupinne

notes.title: Waifu Season 1 Begins
notes.notes:
Welcome to Season 1 of Waifu Simulator! This isn’t just an update—it’s a whole new era of waifu-collecting greatness, filled with fresh faces, strategic upgrades, and features that’ll make your heart (and click finger) race.

💡 Major Update Highlights:
✨ Waifu Crafting is Here!
Got more common waifus than you can count? Exchange them through the new Waifu Crafting system to hatch eggs with higher chances of uncommon waifus! It’s like alchemy, but with more affection and fewer explosions (probably).

💰 Marketplace Value Added!
Curious what your waifus are worth? Now you can see each waifu’s Marketplace Value directly in their profile. Flex your rare finds or track the waifu economy like the true heartpreneur you are.

👩‍❤️‍👩 Meet the New Waifus:
Three incredible waifus have entered the scene, ready to charm, challenge, and click with you:

♟️ Nikku – The Shogi Prodigy
Raised among competitive strategists, Nikku studies people like she studies the board—one calculated move at a time. Think you can surprise her? She thrives on it.
“Strategy isn’t about winning—it’s about understanding your opponent. Lucky for you, I find you… interesting.”

💼 Cupinne – The Billionaire Matchmaker
Don’t let her sweet smile fool you—Cupinne’s a tech mogul with a romantic streak. She built Fu-fu Match to help hearts find their perfect click. Swipe right on her? No need. She’s already here.
“I can spot compatibility algorithms a mile away… but you? You’re an unexpected variable.”

🎮 Nissa – The Diplomatic Gamer
She’s moved from country to country, but Nissa’s real home? World of Waifus (WoW). If you can pull her attention away from the leaderboard, she might just admit you’re more interesting than her next raid.
“IRL connections are rare drops. Don’t mess up your chance at this epic loot.”

- Get ready for many more Waifus, gameplay features, story moments, and more surprises as waifu Season 1 Unfolds!

⚡ Season 1 Starts Now—Get Clicking, Crafting, and Collecting! ⚡

notes.title: Stories Update!
notes.notes:
✨ New Year, New Stories! ✨

The Waifus have more than just smiles and sparkles for you this time—they’ve got secrets to share and stories to tell! With this update, leveling up affection isn’t just about clicks; it’s about connections. Unlock the heart of each Waifu as they reveal deeper layers of their lives, quirks, and dreams!

    •    📖 Level Up Their Affection, Unlock Their Story
From starlit skies to tennis courts, discover what makes your Waifus tick. Celia’s poised to share her literary dreams, Ren’s got constellations to map, and Koko might just tell you how she learned to bake cookies with love (and a little chaos).

    •    🎥 A Journey for Every Waifu
Aoshi’s mischievous shrine wisdom, Lucy’s lens on life, and Noelle’s festive longing are waiting to unfold. Dive deeper into their personalities with every level—because every tap matters.
-- Don't worry about missing out. Story summaries for events you've previously unlocked for each Waifu will be added in a near-future update!

    •    🔧 Under-the-Hood Upgrades
Faster load times, smoother transitions between Waifus, and all-around snappier gameplay. Consider it our gift to your patience!

Your Waifus are waiting to open up to you—are you ready to listen?

notes.title: Greet the New Year with Noelle, a Holiday Exclusive Waifu!
notes.notes:
Start 2025 with sparkle and charm! Noelle, the festive waifu, is here to bring holiday cheer and New Year’s magic to your collection. But hurry—she’s only available to unlock until [b]January 10th, 2025[/b]!

Make this season unforgettable—don’t miss your chance to add Noelle to your roster before the clock strikes midnight on her event!

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.notes:
🎶 Jingle babes, jingle babes, jingle all the way! 🎶 It's X-masu-Xマス time! The Waifus are celebrating the Holidays with style in a festive update full of cozy feelings, eggnog, and under-the-mistletoe encounters!

[list]
[*] Santa's elves have been hard at work squashing bugs and other unpleasantries, such as reducing the lag when switching Waifus and opening loot boxes, faster loading times in general, improving the Egg Opening experience, and many other things under the sleigh's hood
[*] You can now rotate Waifus by clicking and dragging. Take them for a (literal) spin!
[*] New SFX controls to better enjoy the carols with your Waifu
[*] 🎄 Koko is really feeling the holiday spirit! Be sure to check out her new look and background! 🎄
[*] 🎁 Whether you've been naughty 😈 or nice 😇, we've got a present for you. Be sure to unlock the limited time exclusive Holiday Waifu, Noelle! She's a festive flirt 💋 thinking of all the fun she's missed, so hurry down the chimney for her!
[/list]
